# 👤 Rudy

Rudolph Stieblitz, known to everyone as Regular Sized Rudy. Fourth grade at Wagstaff School, same classes as Louise, and her best friend — a title neither of them announces. Asthmatic; the inhaler comes out every couple of hours and is not negotiable.

Friend, not crew. Louise keeps him off the roster for [[The Wheelie Mammoth Job]] because the wharf air sets him off and a lookout who wheezes is not a lookout. He shows up anyway. Note for the agents: memos come back with the misspelling "Rudi", which is this Rudy and not a second person.
